ns2:section.sectionText: This course covers information and knowledge in the workplace, building effective knowledge management strategies, and examining technologies for knowledge management, specifically Microsoft SharePoint. Some topics covered will include knowledge management objectives, business process analysis and improvement, information governance and standards, and strategic planning. The course prepares students on how to build a successful knowledge process for an organization. Emphasis will be on case studies, projects, and hands-on learning.
